C++ — Overview and integration

The C SDK is supplied as a shared library for Windows x64, Linux x86_64, and Linux ARM64. Each platform package contains headers, the shared library, and CMake package files. A C17 compiler and CMake 3.23 or later are required.

Run the examples

cd <SDK_DIR>/cpp/examples
cmake -S . -B build
cmake --build build --config Release

The supplied CMake project selects the package for the current platform automatically.

Integrate into a CMake project

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(my_app LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(epiceye_sdk CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(my_app main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(my_app PRIVATE epiceye_sdk::epiceye_sdk)

For a custom installation location, configure CMake with -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<install-directory>.

Usage

#include "epiceye.h"

TFTech::EpicEyeInfo info;
if (TFTech::EpicEye::getInfo("127.0.0.1:5000", info))
{
    // Use info.
}
